Whether the level should track form evidence for the seams with the genre hold disclosed separately is a calibration question this lens can raise but not settle; raised rather than converted into a confidence-move verdict.

The cedar unit's length disclosure measures itself against the fourteen-to-sixteen verse allowance, which the ruled granularity grants to measured and listed blocks; this unit is neither, and the governing target density is lower. Conservative rather than wrong, and the mechanical cap arm is green either way, but the benchmark named is not the one that governs.

Whether the cure at Ezek.32.17 should state that the witnesses name no month or simply drop the month from the gloss is a convention question, not a factual one; the other dated oracles in this cluster do carry a month, so bare silence would read as an omission rather than as a property of the text.
